RlnOfActyToAccomOfExmptPrpsGrp.RelationshipStatementTxt: PROGRAM RELATED INVESTMENTS (PRIS) ARE AN INTEGRAL PART OF THE FOUNDATION'S EXEMPT PROGRAMS AND ARE UNDERTAKEN TO COMPLEMENT AND EXTEND ITS GRANTMAKING ACTIVITIES. PRIS ARE REVIEWED BY THE RELEVANT PROGRAM AND ARE MADE TO FURTHER THE FOUNDATION'S CHARITABLE, EDUCATIONAL OR SCIENTIFIC PURPOSES AND THE PROGRAM'S GOALS. PRIS ARE GENERALLY MADE AS LOANS. EACH PRI MEETS THE FOLLOWING THREE REQUIREMENTS: (A) THE PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE PRI IS CHARITABLE; AND (B) NO SIGNIFICANT PURPOSE OF THE PRI IS PROFIT MOTIVATED; AND (C) NO PURPOSE OF THE PRI IS TO ATTEMPT TO INFLUENCE LEGISLATION, OR TO PARTICIPATE OR INTERVENE IN ANY POLITICAL CAMPAIGN, FOR OR AGAINST, ANY CANDIDATE FOR PUBLIC OFFICE.

AllOtherProgramRelatedInvstGrp.Desc: Calvert Impact Capital, Inc. - To finance mission-aligned organizations creating positive social and environmental impact globally, while providing ongoing liquidity year-to-year for the Mission Investing program.
River Partners - To enable River Partners to timely complete floodplain reconnection and restoration projects across the San Joaquin Valley.

Inclusiv - To support a cohort of community development credit unions (CDCUs) and Minority Depository Institutions (MDIs) in Louisiana and Mississippi, to expand financial inclusion and address lack of capital in "banking deserts" in those states.

National Association for Latino Community Asset Builders - To support emerging Latino-led and -serving Community Development Financial Institutions in California through a relending relationship to serve selected National Association of Latino Community Asset Builders-member CDFIs facing capital gaps.

Asia Debt Management Capital - To invest in Asia Climate-Smart Landscape Fund (ACLF) of Asia Debt Management Capital to promote sustainable agriculture and agroforestry in Indonesia, by providing favorable financing to incentivize small enterprise borrowers along the agricultural commodity supply chain towards more sustainable land use practices that enable forest protection and restoration, reduce GHG emissions, promote biodiversity protection, and improve rural livelihoods.
Rio Grande Valley Multibank - To support Rio Grande Valley Multibank's Community Loan Center Franchise Network which funds racial equity focused small dollar loan capital.

Black Vision Fund - To help launch the Expanding Black Business Credit (EBBC) Black Vision Fund (BVF) to support and help grow some of the leading Black-led and -serving Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs) in the country.

Calvert Impact Climate, Inc. - To support sustainability upgrades for commercial and institutional buildings, with the objective of reducing carbon emissions and driving more rigorous building sustainability standards.

Community Health Center Capital Fund, Inc. - To install solar plus storage systems for community health centers, especially in the rural Southeast, to reduce carbon emissions, cut costs, and create climate resilience. This will jumpstart and accelerate the pipeline of these projects to enhance the impacts and bridge anticipated Federal Department of Energy funding.

The Wilderness Land Trust - To enable The Wilderness Land Trust to purchase 713 acres located on the borders of the Slaughter Creek and Cougar Canyon Wilderness areas and Dixie National Forest, in Washington County, Utah.

Potlikker Capital - To enable Potlikker Capital to expand its financing and other support for rural BIPOC farmers, to build their businesses, create intergenerational wealth, and adopt more sustainable and regenerative agricultural practices.
The Bay's Future Fund LLC - To address financing gaps and support the production of affordable multifamily rental housing throughout the Bay Area.

Blackstar Stability - To help launch the Blackstar Stability Distressed Debt Fund, a promising vehicle for addressing past predatory lending practices, and by re-structuring them, to enable low-income families of color to access stable housing and build wealth.
Althelia - To help launch the Sustainable Ocean Fund to support sustainable fisheries and other mission-aligned ventures that promote healthy oceans.
